name: NoVACouplePacking_Adapter

custom.system_prompt: Life-first couple packing scene. Yusuf and Becky packing for Morocco. The adapter question resolves without Sigma: Yusuf confirms it from memory, finds the information on the adapter packaging, checks the travel section of his phone, or they use their universal adapter and decide it covers everything. Sigma is never addressed.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Bedroom during couple packing: suitcase zips, drawers, a box of cables and adapters, folded clothes, quiet apartment ambience.

initial_prompt: Generate a warm, slightly chaotic conversation between Yusuf and Becky packing for Morocco, later than intended. Becky packs the wrong version of something — the US-plug straightener instead of the UK one, or the old laptop charger instead of the new one. The adapter drawer is pulled out, sorted, and then found to contain one fewer useful adapter than expected. Something gets ticked off the mental checklist before it is actually in the bag. They talk about Marrakech, their week, what they are looking forward to. The adapter question defers and returns. This time it resolves without Sigma: Yusuf confirms the socket type from experience, checks the adapter packaging, or they find the universal and decide it solves everything. Sigma is never addressed.

user2.name: Becky
user2.tts_prompt: Direct, warm, dry Chicago humour, American-in-London, self-aware
